qualification: local A05.4 inline-TLB write-fault recovery acceptance; not atomic recovery, hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

diagnosis.faultSite: musl _Fork direct CALL at guest image offset 0x5c650, metadata instruction index 2
diagnosis.rootCause: The generated CALL decremented RSP before its return-address push faulted. The rejected checkpoint covered write-bearing statements but not write-bearing terminators, so interpreter retry decremented RSP a second time and later returned through an invalid executable address.

candidate.acceptedBoundary: Baseline instructions checkpoint their exact IR-derived GPR write set and RFLAGS before a write-bearing statement. Direct and indirect CALL terminators checkpoint RSP and RFLAGS before the generated stack push. A successful write clears the active checkpoint; a generated write resolver page fault restores it, publishes the completed prefix, and interpreter-deoptimizes only the faulting instruction.
candidate.accountingBoundary: A recovered generated prefix remains baseline-JIT retirement; the same-call interpreter retry is counted separately as interpreter retirement.
candidate.conservativeBoundary: Generated atomic resolver faults do not publish a recovery PC and retain whole-block rollback plus interpreter replay.

verification.focused: 59 tests in the ABI, metadata-fault, and restartability suites passed.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,552 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then the same pinned inputs were executed explicitly.
targetedCoverage: exact clear_page_orig prefix register and flag state
exact musl loader RIP-relative prefix state
read-succeeds/write-faults RMW restoration at instruction entry
musl _Fork CALL return-address push restoration to pre-decrement RSP
write resolver precise PC publication and atomic resolver fail-closed behavior

diagnosticTraceRun.purpose: Trace-enabled confirmation only; clean-run acceptance uses the committed runner below.

disposition.reason: The exact failing production terminator is covered by a MAP_JIT regression, and two independent clean committed-runner executions crossed the former deterministic reset boundary, four aggregate code-cache wraps, all seven authenticated workloads, and clean ACPI poweroff.
disposition.remainingA05_4Work: Atomic resolver page faults remain conservative and require their own isolated fault-site diagnosis, checkpoint contract, and two-run production reliability proof.

limitations: Two passing local runs are a bounded reliability check, not cross-host qualification.
The checkpoint is intentionally limited to baseline write instructions and CALL terminators represented by the current IR; atomic recovery remains disabled.
This evidence does not satisfy the greater-than-95-percent dispatcher gate or G1-G5.
